court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
case_name: Assistant Commissioner Of Cgst And ... vs Sutherland Global Services Private ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Assistant Commissioner of CGST and Central Excise, Guindy Division, 3rd Floor, EVR Periyar Maligai, 690, Anna Salai, Nandanam, Chennai 600 035.
parties.respondent_defendant: Sutherland Global Services Private Limited, 45-A, Velacherry Main Road, Vijayanagaram, Chennai 600 042.

facts_of_case: The Assistant Commissioner of CGST and Central Excise filed an appeal against the order dated 05.09.2019 made in W.P.No.4773 of 2018 on the file of this Court. The question arises as to whether the Assessee is entitled to utilise and set off the accumulated unutilised amount of Education Cess, Secondary and Higher Education Cess and Krishi Kalyan Cess against the Output GST Tax Liability.

legal_principles.principle: A CENVAT Credit of Education Cess and Secondary and Higher Education Cess which has been availed prior to the cut-off date cannot be cross-utilised as against excise duty and service tax.
legal_principles.held: The Hon'ble Delhi High Court upheld that the CENVATCredit of Education and Secondary Higher Education Cess which had been availed till the cut of date had lapsed to the Government and could not be cross utilised and could not be allowed to be cross utilised as against excise duty and service tax.
cited_cases: CellularOperators Association of India v UOI (2018) 51 GSTR 338 (Del), MANU/DE/0710/2018

legal_principles.principle: A claim that becomes a dead claim cannot be revived after a time gap.
legal_principles.held: The levy having been withdrawn in the year 2015, the availed credit could neither be utilised post 2015 nor can it be transitioned into Goods and Service Tax Act, 2017 regime.
cited_cases: UOI v. Uttam Steels Ltd. (2015) 13 STC 209

outcome.final_order: The Assessee is entitled to utilise and set off the accumulated unutilised amount of Education Cess, Secondary and Higher Education Cess and Krishi Kalyan Cess against the Output GST Tax Liability.
